papers.title: 3D bioprinting processes: A perspective on classification and terminology
papers.abstract: This article aims to provide further classification of cell-compatible bioprinting processes and examine the concept of 3D bioprinting within the general technology field of 3D printing. These technologies are categorized into four distinct process categories, namely material jetting, vat photopolymerization, material extrusion and free-form spatial printing. Discussion will be presented on the definition of classification with example of techniques grouped under the same category. The objective of this article is to establish a basic framework for standardization of process terminology in order to accelerate the implementation of bioprinting technologies in research and commercial landscape.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage and lacks experimental validation or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 为3D生物打印过程提供分类并标准化术语。
summary_zh.method: 将生物打印技术分为材料喷射、光聚合、材料挤出和自由空间打印四类。
summary_zh.result: 建立了生物打印过程分类的基本框架。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，属于观点性讨论。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a classification framework for cell-compatible bioprinting processes and standardize terminology.
summary_en.method: Categorizes bioprinting techniques into material jetting, vat photopolymerization, material extrusion, and free-form spatial printing.
summary_en.result: Established a basic framework for process classification to accelerate implementation in research and industry.
summary_en.validation: This perspective paper does not include experimental validation.

papers.title: Short-term outcomes of one-stage bilateral total hip arthroplasty in young patients (< 30 years old)
papers.abstract: Total hip arthroplasty is one of the best treatments for restoring function and activity in young patients with advanced joint diseases. One-Stage Bilateral Total Hip Arthroplasty (BTHA) offers many advantages, which are important to younger patients and diminished costs and time in comparison with sequential THA. There is currently much concern about the safety of this procedure. The current study was designed to provide more information regarding THA in patients aged 30 years old or younger. Between April 2010 and September 2015, arthroplasty procedures were performed on 180 patients at the surgical centers of Erfan and Milad, Tehran, Iran. The patients that were entered in the study included those with bilateral hip involvement of Avascular Necrosis (AVN), Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA), Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis (JRA), Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis (SCFE), and Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH). The patients underwent one-stage bilateral total hip arthroplasties through the direct lateral approach. Standardized questionnaires were used to obtain mean Postel-Merle d'Aubigné (PMA) score, Oxford Hip Score (OHS), Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) Score, and Modified Harris Hip Score (MHHS), both preoperatively and post-operatively to evaluate functional outcomes. All patients were in the American Society of Anesthesiology (ASA) category 1 or 2. All complications were followed closely for a period of 4.67±0.54 years. From 141 males and 39 females, 84 patients had been recognized as ASA 1, and 96 as ASA 2. Mean age of patients was 27.04±2.74 years old (range: 16 to 30). The mean operation time and the average length of hospital stay were 156±23 minutes and 5.20±2.44 days, respectively. Overall, 3 patients developed unilateral temporary peroneal nerve palsy (1.66%), 2 intraoperative fracture (1.11%), and 2 patients (1.11%) showed deep vein thrombosis. There was no wound infection. Regarding the functional scores in the diagnosis of patients, improvement was better in AVN than, RA, JRA, SCFE, and DDH, respectively. There were significant differences between diagnosis and every functional score, individually (P<0.05). The current results showed that one-stage bilateral THA led to improvement in hip function and stable implant fixation at short to midterm follow up, which suggests the efficacy of one-stage cementless THA in bilateral advanced arthritis in patients younger than 30 years old.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文仅报告了年轻患者双侧全髋置换的临床功能结果和并发症，没有进行任何生物力学建模或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no implant design evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估30岁以下患者一次双侧全髋置换的短期临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性临床研究，记录功能评分和并发症。
summary_zh.result: 一次双侧全髋置换改善了髋关节功能，假体固定稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 平均4.67年临床随访，无对照组。

summary_en.motivation: To assess clinical outcomes of one-stage bilateral total hip arthroplasty in patients under 30 years old.
summary_en.method: Prospective clinical study collecting functional scores (PMA, OHS, VAS, MHHS) and complications over a mean follow-up of 4.67 years.
summary_en.result: One-stage bilateral THA shows improved hip function and stable implant fixation at short-term follow-up with low complication rates.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up of 180 patients with no control group or biomechanical validation.

papers.title: Characterisation of Additively Manufactured Inconel 718 via Laser Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究非生物医用镍基合金的增材制造表征，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding or fatigue testing for implants, and no surface morphology or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 表征激光粉末床熔融增材制造Inconel 718的性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF工艺制备样品并进行力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了Inconel 718的力学性能数据。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证工艺参数影响。

summary_en.motivation: This paper aims to characterize the properties of additively manufactured Inconel 718 via laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated using LPBF and subjected to mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Mechanical properties of LPBF Inconel 718 were obtained and analyzed.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing under various process parameters.
